text: tess: Heads-up — I pushed a compact-dashboard PR that adds percentile-based threshold shading for density sparklines. Quick UX + a11y review? alex: Nice start. My worry: when smoothing is enabled the spikes get visually muted and users miss anomalies. maria: Agree. Two options I see: 1) keep a semi-transparent raw-data overlay so spikes still read, or 2) add a discrete sentinel marker (dot) where values cross the threshold. jon: From infra/eng POV: overlay is cheap (single extra canvas layer). Marker needs index mapping but is doable. We can do overlay + optional marker for keyboard/ARIA. samira: A11y: overlay alone isn't enough. Keyboard users and screen readers need explicit context: announce when a series "exceeded the 90th percentile" and give min/median/max. Also ensure focus order for sparklines/legend. maria: Suggested microcopy change for the control: instead of "Threshold shading" maybe "Highlight extremes (90th+)" — clearer for non-technical PMs. alex: I like that. Short and explicit. jon: Implementation note: when smoothing is toggled we should render overlay based on raw indices, not smoothed points, so markers map to true anomalies. Exposing rawIndices in the chart API will help. I'll add to the PR. maria: For the sentinel marker, design preference: hollow ring with 2px stroke + subtle halo so it doesn't obscure the sparkline. Color = warning color token. samira: For screen readers, here's an aria pattern I propose: a single inline live region per sparkline with a short summary string. e.g. ``` Sparkline: min 0.2, median 0.6, max 1.0. 1 anomaly above 90th percentile at latest point. ``` samira: Also, ensure legend toggle controls have `aria-pressed` and clear labels like "Toggle smoothing — on". maria: Copy tweak for tooltip: current "value" -> "value (raw)" when overlay is visible, and show "value (smoothed)" when smoothing is active. Helps prevent confusion. jon: PR link: — adding rawIndices export and marker layer. Note: overlay layer should be GPU-composited to avoid main-thread repaint churn. figma-bot: Updated mock in Figma with sentinel markers and live-region copy :white_check_mark: tess: Great. I'll update the ticket with acceptance criteria: overlay on by default, optional sentinel in settings, aria live summary, legend toggles tabbable, copy changes applied. Also add perf note about compositing. alex: Quick nit — wording in settings: "Highlight extremes (90th+)" should probably show the percentile value inline so customers know it's configurable. maria: Good call. We'll show "Highlight extremes (90th%)" and make the percentile a dropdown in advanced settings. tess: Sounds good. I'll merge the copy + a11y items into the PR and ping when ready. alex: :thumbsup:
